hotel_1star_room_2p.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last week; generic city trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days; August monthly value.

hotel_1star_room_2p.reason: Generic all-hotel trend was rejected as class-ambiguous; no exact-city 1-star trend was returned.
